set.body:
Outcome: a reviewable Release A candidate containing the guard, complete feature specifications, and qualified optional estimators. Designer work is not a prerequisite.

Scope: migration documentation, method/default policy, reproducible examples, final acceptance execution, source-package qualification, and a revision-bound receipt. Reuse the existing bounded build/check and parity harness instead of inventing another pipeline.

Acceptance:
- Guard, specification, integration, and frozen estimator suites pass on the exact candidate revision; analytical evidence and adverse sensitivity cases are retained.
- Existing numeric parity fixtures pass with mlv2023 still the default. Explain metadata fixture changes separately from numerical changes.
- Run relevant full package tests and bounded R CMD check; no new errors/warnings, and triage notes. Preserve applicable repository coverage and cross-platform requirements. Report local, hosted, and actual platform execution separately; unavailable checks remain explicit blockers to the claims they support.
- Document pixels-per-degree calibration, estimator selection/versions, model-binding migration, invalidation, missingness, and the intended default transition policy.
- Record exact source/archive identity, commands, environments, fixture identities, runtime/memory observations, and scientific limits. No general superiority claim from parity alone.
- Close only when the stated release-candidate gates are met. No CRAN submission, Git push, tag, deployment, or other external publication is authorized by this ticket's planning creation.
set.title: Qualify the feature-contract and estimator release independently of the designer
